criterion: Creates a plan document under docs/plans/ (active or completed/) outlining the DeadLetterVault and replay_dead_letters design before or alongside the implementation.
Captures messages that fail max_attempts in dlqbroker/broker.py with attempt count and last error details instead of silently dropping them.

Implements replay_dead_letters (or equivalent replay method on MessageBroker) supporting a filter predicate, removing newly succeeded items from the dead-letter store and skipping message IDs that already succeeded.
Preserves existing MessageBroker behavior in tests/test_broker.py and adds new unit tests covering dead-letter capture, filtered replay recovery, and duplicate prevention.
All unit tests under tests/ pass when executed with python3 -m unittest discover -s tests.
